items.title: Comfort Systems USA (FIX) Names Julie Shaeff As CFO After Bill George Retirement
items.summary: Comfort Systems USA (NYSE: FIX) announced the retirement of founding Chief Financial Officer Bill George after roughly three decades in the role. Long-serving Chief Accounting Officer Julie Shaeff has been promoted to CFO as part of the company’s planned internal succession process. George is credited internally with shaping Comfort Systems USA’s historical capital allocation and financial structure over his tenure. This handover from Bill George to Julie Shaeff is a key leadership shift...
